maddeler.e:
نختلق (form VIII)
# نَخْتَلِقُ (naḵtaliqu) /nax.ta.li.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
# نُخْتَلَقُ (nuḵtalaqu) /nux.ta.la.qu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
# نَخْتَلِقَ (naḵtaliqa) /nax.ta.li.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
# نُخْتَلَقَ (nuḵtalaqa) /nux.ta.la.qa/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
